title: generate_report output
description: Admin action generate_report (mcp:admin:generate_report). The call only creates a PENDING admin request that the user approves in the dashboard within 5 minutes, otherwise it expires (MCP §4.1). Nothing executes from MCP. Every output carries env, tier, as_of_utc and health (MCP §4.0). No C4 data ever; the login only hashed (MCP-040). Errors use the generic MCP-042 shape, which is outside this schema.

anyOf.description: Null: this output has no performance tier.

health.description: Aggregate health at as_of_utc, so stale or unhealthy data is never mistaken for live (MCP §4.0).

params.description: FIXTURE when fixture parameters are in effect (RISK-066).
